tokens.name: page-bg
tokens.usage: Page ground, as rendered behind the page's content (the body gradient, averaged). Every text pairing below is checked against it.

tokens.name: page-text
tokens.usage: Default body text on `page-bg`: the colour most of the page's text uses that reads on it (9.6:1).

tokens.name: page-surface
tokens.usage: Surface most of the page's running text sits on (cards, panels).

tokens.name: summit-white
tokens.usage: Snow-covered peaks, high-altitude purity, glacial. Used as text on `.logo`, `.nav-link`. 1.0:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: rock-granite
tokens.usage: Ancient mountain stone, solid foundations, climbing. Used as text on `.page-subtitle`, `.stat-label`, `.elevation-label`. 7.2:1 on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: alpine-blue
tokens.usage: High-altitude sky, crisp mountain air, clear weather. Used as text on `.logo:hover`, `.weather-value`, `.footer-section h3`. 3.5:1 on `page-bg` — large text (24px+) or non-text marks only.

tokens.name: safety-orange
tokens.usage: Emergency equipment, rescue visibility, avalanche. Used as text on `.stat-change.alert`. 2.6:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: ice-gray
tokens.usage: Glacier surfaces, morning frost, metal equipment, neutral. Used as text on `.weather-label`, `.footer-links a`, `.footer-bottom`. 1.2:1 on `page-bg` — under 3:1 here, as in the source: use it only on the lighter or darker fills the reference page pairs it with, never as text on `page-bg`.

tokens.name: pine-green
tokens.usage: Alpine forests, base camp vegetation, safety zones below. Used as text on `.stat-change.positive`. 7.2:1 on `page-bg`.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Hero and page titles, set in uppercase — as `h1.page-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-2
styles.usage: Section headings, set in uppercase — as `h2.section-title` on the reference page.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Card and module titles, set in uppercase — as `h3` on the reference page.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button labels, set in uppercase — as `button.btn-primary` on the reference page.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Body copy — as `td` on the reference page.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, eyebrows and table headers, set in uppercase — as `div.stat-label` on the reference page.
